note: The weekly loop's first challengers, from the research (24 Nov 2026): what the research was unsure of, ranked, alternating first-second and look tests.

candidates.test: a darker satellite-like base (more relief, less paper sheet) against the champion's spotlit paper India
candidates.why: all four references sit on satellite/relief; our champion keeps the relief only as depth

candidates.test: 55-70 s every-state fills against the 25-50 s champion
candidates.why: the top every-state hit runs 77 s; the scan's best band is 20-50 s More evidence 2026-11-27: Geo Study's top Shorts run 56 s (Aravalli, 1.67M), 74 s (Kalpasar, 1.1M) and 83 s (UP's 75 districts, 337K) (vidIQ listing). More evidence 2026-11-28 (market.json, first scan with India Maps): the lane splits by format. Every-state fills run long (Naksha Nama's 'har rajya ki mashhoor actress' 91 s, 763K on 2.6K subs; India Pulse's 'har rajya ka khel' 56 s, 144K on 7K subs), while size comparisons run short (Geo Space 16-22 s, 94K-379K). Test the longer length on every-state fills first.

candidates.test: a two-option comment poll end card instead of the loop back to frame 0
candidates.why: QuickShot Maps (6K subs, 1.6M) ends on a poll; comments may lift the feed. More evidence 2026-11-28 (reviewer): the loop's comment ask is where the last viewers go in all three Shorts with drop points (v-20261125-61 15.6% at 34.2 s on 'आपका स्टेट कब बना? कमेंट कीजिए।', v-20261125-62 13.6% at 31.4 s, v-20261124-61 10.5% at 35.7 s) and none of them has a comment yet; end hold is 13-20%.

candidates.test: the title keeps the Hinglish question and adds a Devanagari search tail ('... ? | भारत का नक्शा'), against the champion's question alone
candidates.why: In the niche scan's top 30 Shorts (research/scan.json topIds), every on-lane hit names the search phrase in the title (MIND SPARK 'India Political Map | All States & Union Territories', Study Buddy 'भारत का मानचित्र हिंदी में | सभी राज्य...', the 3,964x Study Spark breakout 'भारत का मानचित्र | राज्य और पड़ोसी देश'); 3 of the 6 on-lane titles carry Devanagari, none of our 3 do. The scan's title split backs keeping the question (median 25.8K views with a question vs 10.8K without) and a name (17.9K vs 3.6K). Low confidence: views tell reach, and stayed may not move. More evidence 2026-11-27: Geo Study's (858K subs) top Shorts this autumn carry a Devanagari question after the label (1.67M 'Aravalli Range & Rajasthan Climate | अरावली ने बांट दिया राजस्थान को दो हिस्सों में?'), and ACE IAS's best Shorts this week put the subject first and a pipe label after ('Western Ghats vs Eastern Ghats | 7 Major Differences', 326K on 19.5K subs).

history.test: a claim on the lit map as the first line ('Bharat ka sabse naya rajya sirf 12 saal purana hai') instead of a question
history.why: 3 of 4 references open on a question; the geography channel's best Short opened on a contradiction you can see
